reviewer: root, with independent reference_research review agreeing on rejection
improvements: Branch-supported broadleaf and gold leaf groups have varied height and more natural gaps instead of one flat horizontal shelf.
Gold ring is much clearer; cabin windows, roof and moon remain readable.
Curved smaller leaves are less like the old large angular paper layers.
blockingProblems: The right conifer is too sparse: long bare branches and fine needle traces read as a weak or unfinished tree in path, island and close views.
Broadleaf and gold crowns moved upward; close-view tops are cropped and the main path loses much of its upper foliage mass.
Improved openings do not compensate for the overall loss of greenery and right-side visual weight.
nextAction: Keep the branch and curved-leaf approach. Restore irregular three-dimensional mid/lower conifer foliage, modestly lower upper broadleaf/gold crowns while preserving the readable ring and cabin. Produce a separately retained world-v12 candidate from world-v10; do not overwrite this rejected source or its evidence.
scope: Static original Windows Player screenshots at the same recorded cameras, light and material settings. Not FPS, dynamic wind/aliasing, complete crown close-up, or normal gameplay acceptance. Stable local release remains v12.
